integrity: The proof reduces maximum independent sets to maximum-weight intersecting support families, obtains a sharp complementary-pair bound, and proves attainability and equality classification using positive logarithmic coordinate weights. The verifier independently checks exhaustive small-rank support selections, the equivalent closed formula, and agreement with the published three-factor specialization.
scientific_limitations: All finite-field factors satisfy \(q_i\ge3\); binary factors are excluded.
The theorem is for the standard zero-divisor graph and does not address other ring-associated graph constructions.
The finite checker exhausts complementary-pair selections only through five factors; arbitrary rank is proved analytically.
title: Maximum independent sets in zero-divisor graphs of products of nonbinary finite fields
